Mission.name: Sample Quarry Lowboy Delivery
Mission.summary: Packaged add-on example: tow a staged lowboy from the docks to the Grand Senora quarry.
Mission.description: This repository example demonstrates the LSOL add-on package format. Bring a road tractor to the staged lowboy at the port, tow it to the quarry drop zone, and clear the yard so crews can take over.
